The laughter stays low — somebody's seat is empty, and everybody sees it. For one evening, grief sits at the fire with them instead of standing over them. (−1,664 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)
You clutch your Grandma's Tin Cup, Knife roll, Trail compass, Marked Bus Map, Dispatcher's headset. You're still here. The resonance deepens. (bond 179)
📺 THE NIGHT SHIFT — Sigrun, Zoe, Sahar, Jorge, Maeve brought down Scarred Big Ugly. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
